packageRules.description: Talos — Ottawa only. Scoped per cluster so each cluster upgrades in its own PR and its own tuppr run.
prBodyNotes: Updates `talconfig.yaml` and the tuppr `TalosUpgrade` CR together. Both must
move in the same commit: tuppr rolls every node to whatever the CR says once
any spec change bumps its generation, so a CR left behind is a downgrade.
- [ ] Confirm no other cluster's Talos PR is mid-rollout

packageRules.description: Kubernetes — Robbinsdale only. Scoped per cluster so each cluster upgrades in its own PR and its own tuppr run.
prBodyNotes: Updates `talconfig.yaml` and the tuppr `KubernetesUpgrade` CR together.
The tuppr CR carries a deliberate hold and a `# version-sync: ignore` marker.
If this PR touches it, confirm the hold is meant to be lifted and drop the
marker; otherwise keep the CR pinned and let only `talconfig.yaml` move.
- [ ] Confirm this cluster's Talos upgrade is complete, not mid-rollout
